notes: The published title 'Why Wo@#$%a is a Scrub' is the poster's own surname (Wodicka) masked by DeckTech's word filter; '#' cannot appear in a wiki page title, so this page is titled Chris Wodicka DS and the published title is kept in the source citation.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting stuff (5)': Kashyyyk, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Secret Plans; no objective, so Kashyyyk is the starting location. These count toward the 60.
Posted 'Kashyyyk', 'Sullust', 'Endor' and 'Naboo' dested the Dark system pages (Kashyyyk (Dark), Sullust (Dark), Endor (Dark), Naboo (Dark) from Coruscant); the draft had Light pages.
Posted 'Secret Plans' dested the Special Edition Effect (the Defensive Shield type in the draft was wrong; shields came later).
Posted 'SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons x3 (the good ones from SE)' dested SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons, the Special Edition card.
Posted 'They'll Be Hell To Pay' dested There'll Be Hell To Pay (the Dark A New Hope grabber); 'There is No Try/Oppressive Enforcement' dested the combo effect.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the post is written after Coruscant's release and plays Naboo (Dark) and Keder The Black from Coruscant.
The strategy says he went 2-0 with the deck at an unnamed tournament.
